snippet.description:
College Hoops 2K8 - PlayStation 3 Gameplay (1080p60fps).

College Hoops 2K8 is an American college basketball video game developed by Visual Concepts and published by 2K Sports for PlayStation 2, PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in 2007.
